subject: Cloud channel onboarding: SKU selection & co-sell checklist
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Costa <anna@marketbridge.com>, Ben Liu <ben.liu@azurepartner.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud channel onboarding: SKU selection & co-sell checklist

Team + Anna/Ben —

Thanks for jumping on this. MarketBridge is ready to list Redwood in their channel programs across AWS, Azure, and GCP; they’ve asked us to define a small initial set of SKUs, regional availability, and the packaging bundles that will be submitted for co-sell review.

Attached: SKU_proposal_v1.xlsx (pricing + SKU IDs), co_sell_checklist_v1.pdf

High-level asks:
- Agree on 3 entry SKUs (Starter / Pro / Enterprise) that map to marketplace listing artifacts per cloud.
- Confirm initial target regions (we should default to the two highest-revenue regions per cloud).
- Identify any cloud-specific packaging constraints (e.g., Azure plan naming, GCP procurement items).
- List the co-sell artifacts we need to produce this week for MarketBridge (demo tenancy, trial images, procurement PKI info).

I propose a short sync on Wed 8/18 to finalize for doc submission on 8/20. Please reply with recommended SKU-to-cloud mapping and any blockers.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Costa <anna@marketbridge.com>

Subject: Re: Cloud channel onboarding: SKU selection & co-sell checklist

Michael / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. From MarketBridge’s side, a pragmatic approach has worked best: ship 3 SKUs per cloud with unified catalog IDs where possible, then vary region coverage on the marketplace tile. Our immediate preferences:

- AWS: prefer SKU granularity tied to instance-type capability (starter: small vCPU-only, pro: GPU-accelerated general purpose, enterprise: reserved/dedicated offering). Regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1.
- Azure: use Plan/Offer naming conventions — Starter/Standard/Premium. Azure has stricter plan validation; include a short product description per plan. Regions: eastus, northeurope.
- GCP: allow more flexible SKU names but unify pricing unit (per token-equivalent). Recommend regional rollout: us-central1, europe-west1.

I attached our onboarding guide that lists common co-sell artifacts (Marketplace_ONBOARDING_GUIDE.pdf). Key question: do you have a HIPAA/non-prod tenancy we can use for demo users? Also, can you provide a one-page technical summary (50–100 words) per SKU for our listing?

Anna Costa
Head of Cloud Partnerships — MarketBridge
anna@marketbridge.com

Attachments: Marketplace_ONBOARDING_GUIDE.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud channel onboarding: SKU selection & co-sell checklist

On Mon, Aug 16, 2026 at 11:04 AM Anna Costa <anna@marketbridge.com> wrote:
> Michael / team —
> 
> Appreciate the quick turnaround. From MarketBridge’s side, a pragmatic approach has worked best: ship 3 SKUs per cloud...

Copying Anna’s preferences into our internal constraints and a suggested mapping below:

Suggested mapping (initial GA):
- Starter: tiny sequence workloads, CPU-only; Marketplace ID: RW-SKR-START-1
  - Regions: us-east-1 (primary), eu-west-1 (secondary)
- Pro: mixed CPU/GPU, mid-length contexts; Marketplace ID: RW-SKR-PRO-1
  - Regions: us-west-2, northeurope
- Enterprise: high-throughput, reserved instances / dedicated SKU; Marketplace ID: RW-SKR-ENT-1
  - Regions: us-east-1 (backup), europe-west1 (for GCP parity)

Notes / blockers:
- Procurement: for Enterprise we’ll need the customer-facing SLA and compliance addendum in the listing metadata. I’ve flagged Legal for the SLA template; they need the specific region and capacity numbers by EOD 8/17.
- Pricing: need to align per-cloud unit economics; finance will push for separate cloud price sheets. Can Karthik coordinate finance inputs?
- Technical summary: I’ll draft 3x 75-word blurbs for Anna’s listing.

Laura Bennett
Director, Cloud GTM — Redwood Inference

Perfect — good alignment. Final decisions and next steps: 

1) SKU & region set (GA submission):
   - Starter (RW-SKR-START-1): us-east-1, eu-west-1
   - Pro (RW-SKR-PRO-1): us-west-2, northeurope
   - Enterprise (RW-SKR-ENT-1): us-east-1 (reserved), europe-west1
2) Packaging names: use AWS naming exactly as SKU labels above; for Azure we’ll submit Plan names Starter / Standard / Premium and include the same RW-SKR IDs in metadata; GCP listing will map to the same price banding.

3) Owners & deadlines:
   - Ops (Soojin) to provide demo tenancy + seeds by 8/20.
   - Laura to share 3x technical summaries by 8/17 (received).
   - Karthik to consolidate finance price sheet and send to Anna by 8/19.
   - Legal to provide SLA addendum for Enterprise by 8/20.

4) Co-sell artifacts: MarketBridge will validate and request any additional items. Anna — please confirm whether a single "co-sell intake" packet is sufficient for AWS + Azure, or if separate submissions are required.

I’ve created a 30-minute sync for Thu 8/19 to confirm final upload plan (link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/122-cc-onboard). If nothing urgent pops up, we’ll move to submission on 8/20.

Thanks everyone — team will escalate if any blocker surfaces.
